Circumstantial overload might be the most difficult. We can choose not to go to a Norwex party if we need to give our schedule some space. But if a child breaks a leg in the middle of wedding preparations, we have no choice other than to make the best of the situation.

Circumstantial overload may happen slowly, as in the following story, or it may happen quickly as in the case of an accident in which a family member is injured.

Becky is in her thirties with seven children under seventeen. A few years ago, one of their chicken houses burned down. At the time, they were thankful that the chickens had left the day before and that no one was close by when the propane tank exploded.

“My husband faced the disaster like a man,” says Becky. “His calm spirit helped me relax. I felt certain that we could make the financial adjustments and life would go on as before. But I was wrong. Very wrong.”

“In time the mess was cleaned up, and Rick looked into rebuilding. The quotes were higher than expected, so he opted to do some of the work himself. He also took on a part-time job to provide more income. Our boys were old enough to help, yet they couldn’t do much without Rick’s direction.”

“I first felt the adjustment in my wallet, but I consoled myself that this was only temporary. Then the spark in Rick’s eyes was replaced with a dull stare. He became distant from us. I knew something wasn’t right, but I couldn’t put my finger on it.”

“Then he was elected to finish the last four months of secretarial duties for a brother who spent some time in Bulgaria. That night he came home and wept. ‘Doesn’t anyone understand what I’m going through? Every time I turn around, there is something to do. The boys want to go fishing, you need a new clothesline, and the chicken house needs to be finished in six months! I am not mentally capable of handling one more duty.’”

“That was the straw that broke the camel’s back,” Becky said. “I became alarmed when I heard him yawning in the middle of the night and knew that he was not sleeping.”

“It was clear to me that my perfectionist husband was overloaded. More and more Rick leaned on me. I cut back on my commitments and tried to keep my time free so that I was available to help lessen his load.”

“I felt like a lifeguard trying to keep a man from drowning while taking in a bit too much water myself. Many of the home-life responsibilities fell on my shoulders. Then I was asked to fill the position of food committee for Mrs. ‘Going-to-Bulgaria.’”

Unfortunately, circumstantial stress is often unnoticed. Worse yet, the victim can be misunderstood or misjudged. Becky said, “My darkest day came when I was accused of being selfish with my time because I declined the food committee request.”

Prolonged overload can be emotionally and mentally damaging

Intense, long-lasting pressures or troubles shouldered alone can cause severe stress. Minor stress is normal, but prolonged stress can cause depression, anxiety, heart disease, and high blood pressure. How you handle prolonged stress is important.

Sometimes this type of overload is not public knowledge. Traumatic events in our plain circles tend to receive prayer, finances, and weekly budget updates. At the same time, other saints are suffering deeply on the sidelines with little recognition or financial aid. It could be strained relationships or little bills that add up to a big sum. Betrayal and rejection cause stress beyond measure. There are no quick fixes to circumstantial stress, but little sparks of light can help you navigate the darkness.

Talk about your situation with someone you trust

Sometimes just talking about problems can help you to put issues in perspective. Hearing yourself verbalize a stressful situation somehow clears brain fog and gives a clearer path forward.

Find routine

When stress prevails, racing thoughts, forgetfulness, and inability to focus comes uninvited. Having a routine can bring some rhythm to your mental well-being. The smallest normalcy brings a moment of pleasure, and it is soothing to the soul.

Intentionally seek a breather

Lingering stress can cause agitation, moodiness, and the desire to take control. Sometimes it is hard to think beyond mental fog, but it is so important to find refreshment for your mental wellbeing. Stress hormones can speed up your heart rate and tighten your blood vessels. That temporarily raises your blood pressure. The opposite happens when you relax. Being relaxed helps you have a calmer, clearer mind which improves your concentration and decision-making.

Believe that God cares

Say it. Read the Psalms over and over. Listen to good music. Take short walks and pray aloud. Keep your eyes on Jesus. Believe “Weeping may endure for a night, but joy cometh in the morning” (Psalm 30:5).

If you are facing circumstantial overload, be patient and realistic. God will make a way for you. Many times, He opens doors just when we are running out of options. He will supply the needed grace for that hour. And the next hour. And the next. At times, surprising opportunities come, and prayers are answered in unexpected ways. However He chooses to work on your behalf, hold to His unchanging hand.

Regardless of the type of overload you might be encountering, turn to your Heavenly Father.

Ask Him for direction and wisdom. And say with the Psalmist, “In thee, O LORD, do I put my trust: let me never be put to confusion” (Psalm 71:1).

Η υπερφόρτωση λόγω περιστάσεων μπορεί να είναι η πιο δύσκολη. Μπορούμε να επιλέξουμε να μην πάμε σε ένα πάρτι Norwex, αν χρειάζεται να αφήσουμε λίγο κενό στο πρόγραμμά μας. Όμως, αν ένα παιδί σπάσει το πόδι του ενώ γίνονται οι προετοιμασίες για έναν γάμο, δεν έχουμε άλλη επιλογή παρά να κάνουμε ό,τι καλύτερο μπορούμε με την κατάσταση.

Η υπερφόρτωση λόγω περιστάσεων μπορεί να αναπτυχθεί σταδιακά, όπως στην παρακάτω ιστορία, ή να εμφανιστεί ξαφνικά, όπως στην περίπτωση ενός ατυχήματος στο οποίο τραυματίζεται ένα μέλος της οικογένειας.

Η Becky είναι γύρω στα τριάντα και έχει επτά παιδιά κάτω των δεκαεπτά ετών. Πριν από λίγα χρόνια, ένα από τα κοτέτσια τους κάηκε. Τότε, ήταν ευγνώμονες που οι κότες είχαν φύγει την προηγούμενη μέρα και που κανείς δεν ήταν κοντά όταν εξερράγη η δεξαμενή προπανίου.

«Ο άντρας μου αντιμετώπισε την καταστροφή σαν άντρας», λέει η Becky. «Το ήρεμο πνεύμα του με βοήθησε να χαλαρώσω. Ήμουν βέβαιη ότι θα μπορούσαμε να κάνουμε τις απαραίτητες οικονομικές προσαρμογές και η ζωή θα συνεχιζόταν όπως πριν. Αλλά έκανα λάθος. Πολύ μεγάλο λάθος.»

«Με τον καιρό καθαρίστηκε το χάος και ο Rick εξέτασε το ενδεχόμενο να ξαναχτίσει. Οι προσφορές ήταν υψηλότερες απ’ όσο περίμενε, οπότε αποφάσισε να κάνει μόνος του μέρος της δουλειάς. Ανέλαβε επίσης μια δουλειά μερικής απασχόλησης για να φέρνει περισσότερα έσοδα. Τα αγόρια μας ήταν αρκετά μεγάλα ώστε να βοηθήσουν, αλλά δεν μπορούσαν να κάνουν πολλά χωρίς την καθοδήγηση του Rick.»

«Πρώτα ένιωσα την αλλαγή στο πορτοφόλι μου, αλλά παρηγορούσα τον εαυτό μου λέγοντας πως ήταν μόνο προσωρινή. Έπειτα, η σπίθα στα μάτια του Rick αντικαταστάθηκε από ένα άδειο βλέμμα. Απομακρύνθηκε από εμάς. Ήξερα ότι κάτι δεν πήγαινε καλά, αλλά δεν μπορούσα να καταλάβω τι.»

«Έπειτα εκλέχτηκε για να αναλάβει τους τελευταίους τέσσερις μήνες γραμματειακών καθηκόντων ενός αδελφού που έλειψε για κάποιο διάστημα στη Βουλγαρία. Εκείνο το βράδυ γύρισε σπίτι και έκλαψε. “Δεν καταλαβαίνει κανείς τι περνάω; Κάθε φορά που γυρίζω, υπάρχει κάτι να κάνω. Τα αγόρια θέλουν να πάνε για ψάρεμα, χρειάζεσαι καινούργια απλώστρα, και το κοτέτσι πρέπει να είναι έτοιμο σε έξι μήνες! Δεν είμαι διανοητικά ικανός να αναλάβω άλλη μία υποχρέωση.”»

«Αυτό ήταν η σταγόνα που ξεχείλισε το ποτήρι», είπε η Becky. «Ανησύχησα όταν τον άκουσα να χασμουριέται μέσα στη νύχτα και κατάλαβα ότι δεν κοιμόταν.»

«Μου ήταν σαφές ότι ο τελειομανής άντρας μου ήταν υπερφορτωμένος. Ο Rick βασιζόταν όλο και περισσότερο σε μένα. Περιόρισα τις υποχρεώσεις μου και προσπάθησα να κρατήσω ελεύθερο τον χρόνο μου, ώστε να μπορώ να τον βοηθήσω να ελαφρύνει το φορτίο του.»

«Ένιωθα σαν ναυαγοσώστρια που προσπαθεί να μην αφήσει έναν άντρα να πνιγεί, ενώ κι εγώ κατάπινα λίγο παραπάνω νερό. Πολλές από τις ευθύνες της οικογενειακής ζωής έπεσαν στους ώμους μου. Έπειτα μου ζητήθηκε να αναλάβω τη θέση στην επιτροπή φαγητού για την κυρία “Going-to-Bulgaria”.»

Δυστυχώς, το στρες που προκαλείται από τις περιστάσεις συχνά περνά απαρατήρητο. Ακόμη χειρότερα, το άτομο που υποφέρει μπορεί να παρεξηγηθεί ή να κριθεί λανθασμένα. Η Becky είπε: «Η πιο σκοτεινή μου μέρα ήρθε όταν με κατηγόρησαν ότι ήμουν εγωίστρια με τον χρόνο μου, επειδή αρνήθηκα το αίτημα να συμμετάσχω στην επιτροπή φαγητού.»

Η παρατεταμένη υπερφόρτωση μπορεί να βλάψει συναισθηματικά και διανοητικά

Έντονες, μακροχρόνιες πιέσεις ή προβλήματα που επωμιζόμαστε μόνοι μας μπορούν να προκαλέσουν σοβαρό στρες. Το ήπιο στρες είναι φυσιολογικό, αλλά το παρατεταμένο στρες μπορεί να προκαλέσει κατάθλιψη, άγχος, καρδιοπάθειες και υψηλή αρτηριακή πίεση. Είναι σημαντικό το πώς διαχειρίζεσαι το παρατεταμένο στρες.

Μερικές φορές αυτό το είδος υπερφόρτωσης δεν είναι ευρέως γνωστό. Τα τραυματικά γεγονότα στις κοινότητές μας των Plain συνήθως αντιμετωπίζονται με προσευχή, οικονομική βοήθεια και εβδομαδιαίες ενημερώσεις για τον προϋπολογισμό. Την ίδια στιγμή, άλλοι άγιοι υποφέρουν βαθιά στο περιθώριο, με ελάχιστη αναγνώριση ή οικονομική βοήθεια. Μπορεί να πρόκειται για τεταμένες σχέσεις ή μικρούς λογαριασμούς που αθροίζονται σε μεγάλο ποσό. Η προδοσία και η απόρριψη προκαλούν ανυπολόγιστο στρες. Δεν υπάρχουν γρήγορες λύσεις για το στρες που προκαλείται από τις περιστάσεις, αλλά μικρές σπίθες φωτός μπορούν να σε βοηθήσουν να βρεις τον δρόμο σου μέσα στο σκοτάδι.

Μίλησε για την κατάστασή σου με κάποιον που εμπιστεύεσαι

Μερικές φορές, και μόνο το να μιλήσεις για τα προβλήματα μπορεί να σε βοηθήσει να τα δεις στις σωστές τους διαστάσεις. Το να ακούς τον εαυτό σου να περιγράφει μια στρεσογόνα κατάσταση κάπως διαλύει τη νοητική ομίχλη και σου δείχνει πιο καθαρά τον δρόμο προς τα εμπρός.

Βρες μια ρουτίνα

Όταν κυριαρχεί το στρες, οι καλπάζουσες σκέψεις, η αφηρημάδα και η αδυναμία συγκέντρωσης εμφανίζονται απρόσκλητες. Μια ρουτίνα μπορεί να προσφέρει κάποιον ρυθμό στην ψυχική σου ευεξία. Ακόμη και το πιο μικρό στοιχείο κανονικότητας φέρνει μια στιγμή ευχαρίστησης και γαληνεύει την ψυχή.

Αναζήτησε συνειδητά μια ανάπαυλα

Το παρατεταμένο στρες μπορεί να προκαλέσει εκνευρισμό, κυκλοθυμία και την επιθυμία να πάρεις τον έλεγχο. Μερικές φορές είναι δύσκολο να σκεφτείς πέρα από τη νοητική ομίχλη, αλλά είναι πολύ σημαντικό να αναζητήσεις ανανέωση για την ψυχική σου υγεία. Οι ορμόνες του στρες μπορούν να επιταχύνουν τον καρδιακό σου ρυθμό και να συσφίξουν τα αιμοφόρα αγγεία σου. Αυτό αυξάνει προσωρινά την αρτηριακή σου πίεση. Το αντίθετο συμβαίνει όταν χαλαρώνεις. Η χαλάρωση σε βοηθά να έχεις πιο ήρεμο και καθαρό μυαλό, πράγμα που βελτιώνει τη συγκέντρωση και τη λήψη αποφάσεων.

Πίστεψε ότι ο Θεός νοιάζεται

Πες το. Διάβαζε τους Ψαλμούς ξανά και ξανά. Άκου καλή μουσική. Κάνε σύντομους περιπάτους και προσευχήσου δυνατά. Κράτα τα μάτια σου στραμμένα στον Ιησού. Πίστεψε: «Το κλάμα μπορεί να διαρκέσει μια νύχτα, μα το πρωί έρχεται η χαρά» (Ψαλμός 30:5).

Αν αντιμετωπίζεις υπερφόρτωση λόγω περιστάσεων, κάνε υπομονή και μείνε ρεαλιστής. Ο Θεός θα ανοίξει δρόμο για σένα. Πολλές φορές ανοίγει πόρτες ακριβώς όταν μας τελειώνουν οι επιλογές. Θα παράσχει τη χάρη που χρειάζεσαι για εκείνη την ώρα. Και για την επόμενη ώρα. Και για τη μεθεπόμενη. Κάποιες φορές προκύπτουν απροσδόκητες ευκαιρίες και οι προσευχές εισακούονται με αναπάντεχους τρόπους. Όπως κι αν επιλέξει να ενεργήσει για χάρη σου, κρατήσου από το αμετάβλητο χέρι Του.

Όποιο είδος υπερφόρτωσης κι αν αντιμετωπίζεις, στρέψου στον Ουράνιο Πατέρα σου.

Ζήτησέ Του καθοδήγηση και σοφία. Και πες μαζί με τον Ψαλμωδό: «Σε εσένα, Κύριε, έχω θέσει την εμπιστοσύνη μου· ας μην ντροπιαστώ ποτέ» (Ψαλμός 71:1).

A Christ-centered Courtship is a series of messages on godly courtship preached by Paul Hershberger. He preached these messages several times at different locations over the last ten years. Recently, we had them transcribed and abridged for reading clarity. After printing all six articles in The Heartbeat of the Remnant, we will publish them in a booklet. This is the first article of six.

Introduction

My wife and I had the privilege of having a courtship without regrets or guilt. We were blessed with parents who guided us in the right way and gave us opportunities that they didn’t have.

If you don’t have that testimony or memory, please don’t go on a guilt trip. But my prayer for you is that you get a burning burden and vision in your heart to have it for your children. That can be your reward.

A Christ-centered courtship is a period of time between a single life and a married life. The decisions you make in this period will affect you for the rest of your lives. With God’s blessing on your life, you can end up with no regrets or guilt.

Five goals for this Christ-Centered Courtship series.

Goal #1. To turn the hearts of the fathers to their children.

Goal #2. To turn the hearts of the children to their fathers.

Goal #3. That parents would get a burden to lead each one of their children into the perfect will of God for their lives.

Goal #4. That young people would get a burden to seek after God, find fulfillment and purpose in walking with God, and you would seek maturity in your manners and in your character.

Goal #5. That young men and young women would rise up to be godly fathers and godly mothers with a vision to raise up another godly generation, and the Gospel of Jesus Christ can go on.

God’s Plan for Male and Female

Ecclesiastes 12:1 says, “Remember now thy Creator in the days of thy youth, while the evil days come not, nor the years draw nigh, when thou shalt say, I have no pleasure in them.” My desire is that each one of you, remember your Creator in the days of your youth. Turn your heart, your focus, and your life to pursue after your Creator, Almighty God, in heaven.

What does he mean, “while the evil days come not” and “the years draw nigh”? It means to seek the Lord when you’re young. Take the energy of your youth and seek after God. Young people, you’re young and full of ideas, visions, plans, and dreams. I doubt there are any of you who just enjoy sitting down in an easy chair, putting your feet up, and just dreaming about how terrible and horrible life is going to be. We don’t do that, do we? But if we don’t walk with God and follow God’s plan, hard things will come upon us. When hard things come in life, we have no place to turn to. We dream that life will turn out well. The decisions and actions in our youth affect us for the rest of our lives. The good news is they can affect us in a good way. The bad news is they can affect us in a bad way. It depends on what decisions and choices we make. But young people, you’re young, and you have the opportunity to choose.

Let’s go to the beginning of Genesis.

“And the LORD God said, It is not good that the man should be alone; I will make him an help meet for him. And out of the ground the LORD God formed every beast of the field, and every fowl of the air; and brought them unto Adam to see what he would call them: and whatsoever Adam called every living creature, that was the name thereof. And Adam gave names to all cattle, and to the fowl of the air, and to every beast of the field; but for Adam there was not found an help meet for him. And the LORD God caused a deep sleep to fall upon Adam, and he slept: and he took one of his ribs, and closed up the flesh instead thereof; And the rib, which the LORD God had taken from man, made he a woman, and brought her unto the man. And Adam said, This is now bone of my bones, and flesh of my flesh: she shall be called Woman, because she was taken out of Man. Therefore shall a man leave his father and his mother, and shall cleave unto his wife: and they shall be one flesh” (Genesis 2:18-24).

“And God said, Let us make man in our image, after our likeness: and let them have dominion over the fish of the sea, and over the fowl of the air, and over the cattle, and over all the earth, and over every creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth. So God created man in his own image, in the image of God created he him; male and female created he them. And God blessed them, and God said unto them, Be fruitful, and multiply, and replenish the earth, and subdue it: and have dominion over the fish of the sea, and over the fowl of the air, and over every living thing that moveth upon the earth” (Genesis 1:26-28).

“And the Lord God said, It is not good that the man should be alone; I will make him an help meet for him” (Genesis 2:18). “I’ll make him an help that is meet for him.” God said He would do that.

“So God created man in his own image, in the image of God created he him; male and female created he them” (Genesis 1:27). God made. God created us male and female. It takes a lot of blind faith to believe that we evolved perfectly as male and female. The creation of male and female is God’s plan. It is one of the living proofs of Creation. God made. God created. It’s God’s plan. God is the Author. And God’s plan brings blessing.

I’d like to look at ten different aspects of this blessing of God’s plan.

1) God brings Eve to Adam.

“And the rib, which the Lord God had taken from man, made he a woman, and brought her unto the man. And Adam said, This is now bone of my bones, and flesh of my flesh: she shall be called Woman, because she was taken out of Man” (Genesis 2:22-23).

God caused Adam to fall into a deep sleep. Then God created Eve and brought her to Adam. Adam awoke and realized, “This one is for me!” He had seen all the animals go by when he named them. Now God brings him someone that is for him. He also realized, “She was taken out of my side.” She’s close to his heart. “This is bone of my bones and flesh of my flesh.” It’s not a dog; it’s not a giraffe, or a monkey, or an ape. This one that God brought to him is like him. God’s plan has a blessing.

Adam and Eve had never had a companion before. Adam and Eve had never let the emotions of their heart go before. Something happened in Adam and Eve’s hearts. Adam was a “one-woman man,” and Eve was a “one-man woman.” They never gave their heart passions to anybody else. God has that plan for us, too. God’s plan brings blessings.

2) Leaving and cleaving in unity for life.

“Therefore Bshall a man leave his father and his mother, and shall cleave unto his wife: and they shall be one flesh” (Genesis 2:24).

This verse says, “Therefore shall a man leave his father and his mother,” but Adam and Eve did not have a father and mother. What God is saying it doesn’t work for there to be cleaving unless there’s leaving. Also, in Mark 10:7, we read, “For this cause shall a man leave his father and mother, and cleave to his wife.” This is God’s plan, and God’s plan brings blessing.

Leaving means to leave behind, to abandon. “For this cause shall a man leave his father and mother” is to leave parents leave behind. Let’s consider a young man who has a really good home life. He’s blessed and has everything he needs. Yet once God brings his Eve into his life, something rises up inside him, and he says, “I’m leaving!” But this is God’s plan. And God’s plan brings blessing.

It’s not just leaving his father and mother; he also cleaves to his wife. Cleave means “to glue to, to adhere.” We are very familiar with glued wood panels. All kinds of solid furniture are made out of panels glued together. And if they’re glued together right, they will not come apart at the joints. If you tear them apart, you’re going to have to tear the wood apart. God’s glue is the same way, where it glues two people together. The only way to tear them apart is by splintering and ripping and God does not bless that. But leaving and cleaving, staying together and being glued together, that’s God’s plan and it brings blessing.

3) They shall be one flesh.

“Therefore shall a man leave his father and his mother, and shall cleave unto his wife: and they shall be one flesh” (Genesis 2:24). Two single people who become one married couple, become one unit before God, and become one family before God. They become one flesh, where God sees them as together as one.

“And they twain shall be one flesh: so then they are no more twain, but one flesh. What therefore God hath joined together, let not man put asunder” (Mark 10:8-9). God’s plan for male and female is that He brings Eve to Adam. Then the leaving and cleaving to take place. He causes them to become one flesh. Pulling apart is no blessing at all but bringsagony,pain,travail, and hurt. There is no blessing in separation. But God’s plan brings blessing.

4) Not an unequal yoke.

“Be ye not unequally yoked together with unbelievers: for what fellowship hath righteousness with unrighteousness” (2 Corinthians 6:14-15). “The wife is bound by the law as long as her husband liveth; but if her husband be dead, she is at liberty to be married to whom she will; only in the Lord” (1 Corinthians 7:39).

God’s plan is that marriage is an equal yoke. God will not bring an Eve to an Adam in a marriage that is an unequal yoke.Let’s think about leaving and cleaving, getting glued together, and two becoming one. In marriage, those two are now one before God. Imagine being in a bad marriage relationship like this—a family like this trying to function together. There will be no blessing.

But an equal yoke brings blessing! God desires that we be joined together in one flesh, one heart, and one mind. He wants to see us joined in heart, mind, and fleashthe whole being, being one. God’s plan brings blessing.

5) God planned for us to have children.

“And God blessed them, and God said unto them, Be fruitful, and multiply, and replenish the earth, and subdue it: and have dominion over the fish of the sea, and over the fowl of the air, and over every living thing that moveth upon the earth” (Genesis 1:28). Think of the joy and miracle every time another child is born into a Christian home. God planned it this way. And if God brought Adam his Eve, and they leave and cleave, they become one flesh, one heart, one mind. If they are equally yoked and God blesses them with children, it becomes a joyful haven where God can dwell. “And God blessed Noah and his sons, and said unto them, Be fruitful, and multiply, and replenish the earth” (Genesis 9:1). “And you, be ye fruitful, and multiply; bring forth abundantly in the earth, and multiply therein” (Genesis 9:7). God’s plan brings blessing.

6) Headship order.

“But I would have you know, that the head of every man is Christ; and the head of the woman is the man; and the head of Christ is God” (1 Corinthians 11:3). It is God, and then Christ, the man, and the woman. God established a headship order, and this headship order is a blessing. It’s God’s plan, and it’s a blessing.

“Children, obey your parents in the Lord: for this is right. Honor thy father and mother; which is the first commandment with promise; That it may be well with thee, and thou mayest live long on the earth” (Ephesians 6:1-3). . Children, obey your parents in the Lord is a part of the headship order. This not difficult to understand, is it? A home following the plan of God is just a blessed situation. Young people learn to be under authority. Make that your high priority. The sooner you learn to be under authority, the better you will be prepared for the responsibilities in life.

I remember looking at married life and having aspirations about teaching children and raising a godly family. I listened to the “Godly Home” series and thought I was ready to go. But then the day came when it was my turn and my responsibility, and all of a sudden, my heart wanted to wither. Responsibility doesn’t feel the same as dreaming about it does. YOU need to do something! YOU are responsible. YOU need to make it happen. And, by the way, not just make it happen; you need to make it happen in a Christlike way. You need to make it happen in a way that the anointing of the Spirit of God can come down on your family. The better we learn how to be under authority, the better we’ll be prepared for those responsibilities. The more we realize we need God, the better off we are. Let’s make a high priority out of learning to be under authority as children and as young people. “My son, forget not my law; but let thine heart keep my commandments: For length of days, and long life, and peace, shall they add to thee” (Proverbs 3:1-2).

God will add his blessing if we stay in this headship order. The more you learn how to be under authority, the more you will be blessed when you establish your home. God’s plan has blessings.

7) A godly marriage.

Ephesians 5:21,22,24 says, “Submitting yourselves one to another in the fear of God. Wives, submit yourselves unto your own husbands, as unto the Lord. . . Therefore as the church is subject unto Christ, so let the wives be to their own husbands in every thing.”

First of all look at verse 21, “submitting yourselves one to another.” There’s a blending together that needs to happen in a godly home. This blending together should happen in the fear of God. If we’re submitting one to another in the fear of God, we’re going to obey God because we want His blessings.

Ephesians 5: 22, 24 “Wives, submit yourselves unto your own husbands, as unto the Lord. . . Therefore as the church is subject unto Christ, so let the wives be to their own husbands in every thing.” Young ladies, you can count on it: submission to Dad equals submission to a husband. You can practice while you are single. This will help build character in your life. Being a rebellious and froward woman is not going to bring the blessing of God.

It goes on and says, in Ephesians 5:25,28,29. “Husbands, love your wives, even as Christ also loved the church, and gave himself for it . . . So ought men to love their wives as their own bodies. He that loveth his wife loveth himself. For no man ever yet hated his own flesh; but nourisheth and cherisheth it, even as the Lord the church.” Young men, this says that husbands should love their wives. So who do you think God put in your life to prepare you to love your wife? Your mother! Do you want to learn how to love your wife? Learn how to get along with your mom, love your mom, and care about her. Do you want to practice to love your future wife? Go ahead and love your mom.

Verse 33, “Nevertheless let every one of you in particular so love his wife even as himself; and the wife see that she reverence her husband.” God’s plan brings blessings.

8) Being heirs together of the grace of life.

1 Peter 3:7 “Likewise, ye husbands, dwell with them according to knowledge, giving honor unto the wife, as unto the weaker vessel, and as being heirs together of the grace of life; that your prayers be not hindered.” As husbands, we give honor to the wife. She is the weaker vessel and the one that born the children! She’s gone through a lot of traumatic changes in her life. She’s the one that gets worn out and tires sooner.

And he says, “Husbands, dwell with them according to knowledge.”

Young men, learn to understand your mom and your sisters. It will help you after you get married. Don’t conclude that—ah, that’s just women. No, you want the blessing of God. Learn to know and understand them.

“Being heirs together of the grace of life.” God wants us to be heirs together of the grace of life. If we’re not heirs together of the grace of life, can we be heirs separated of the grace of life? I don’t think so. He says we should be heirs together so that our prayers are not hindered. So if we’re heirs separated, could we say our prayers will be hindered? Yes, our prayers will be hindered. Let’s give honor unto the wife as unto the weaker vessel. Every ounce you can gain in this area will only bless you later. It’s worth it. God’s plan brings blessing.

9) A blessed and secure home.

This comes partly out of 1 Peter 3:7, but also from Psalm 144:12 “That our sons may be as plants grown up in their youth; that our daughters may be as corner stones, polished after the similitude of a palace.” The grace of God is on a secure home where there is unity. Where Dad is understanding Mom, where Dad cares about Mom. Dad is ministering and is there to help and guide. He’s there to give direction with a heart of compassion. God’s plan for male and female—God’s plan brings blessings.

10) As Christ and the church.

“Therefore as the church is subject unto Christ, so let the wives be to their own husbands in every thing. Husbands, love your wives, even as Christ also loved the church, and gave himself for it; That he might sanctify and cleanse it with the washing of water by the word, That he might present it to himself a glorious church, not having spot, or wrinkle, or any such thing; but that it should be holy and without blemish. So ought men to love their wives as their own bodies. He that loveth his wife loveth himself. For no man ever yet hated his own flesh; but nourisheth and cherisheth it, even as the Lord the church” (Ephesians 5:24-29).

“Husbands, love your wives, even as Christ also loved the church, and gave Himself for it.” God is looking for men who are willing to give their lives. Single young men, who are willing to answer the call and give their life. This is a high calling of God. It’s the plan of God.

Young men, are you willing to lay down your life, your agenda, and those independent things you like to do? Are you willing to be patient, gentle, and understanding? Are you willing to lose sleep and keep going even when you’re tired? Are you willing to stay calm and not react in stressful circumstances? Are you willing to lead and guide a wife and children, eternal souls, through this life?

But my plea is that you would volunteer and say, “I’m willing to apply myself to the Word of God, the will of God, the plan of God, and I’ll give my life. I’m willing to lay it on the altar.” Jesus gave His life for us, and He’s comparing the marriage with the church and Him.

There’s also a need for mothers who are submissive and yielded to authority. Mothers who do not follow the women’s lib of our day but are rather content to be keepers at home.

Young ladies, are you willing to enlist? Will you give your heart to be guided and led? Are you willing to follow and to cheerfully submit to your authority? Are you willing to serve and be spent for your family? Are you willing to serve and be spent for YOUR family? If you get married someday, it will be YOUR family that you’ll be serving and being spent for. Are you willing to bear pain and discomfort? Are you willing to be a helpmeet, giving yourself for his burden and vision?

But as we look at God’s plan and blessings, you want God’s blessing, young people! But that means you need to make choices accordingly. Rise up and make decisions that will lead to maturity. Maturity comes with the process of seeking after God. Make a commitment in your heart to open yourself to God’s blessings and principles. I encourage you to walk with God, to have a relationship with Jesus Christ, and to do so in humility.

Seek after Christlike character, and do it on purpose. It is so easy for us to just live life however it happens. But if we make decisions on purpose, it will take us somewhere! Those decisions matter. Do things according to God’s plan.

God has a plan for male and female and he has a plan for you.

«A Christ-centered Courtship» er en serie taler om gudfryktig frieri, forkynt av Paul Hershberger. Han forkynte disse talene flere ganger på forskjellige steder i løpet av de siste ti årene. Nylig fikk vi dem transkribert og forkortet for å gjøre dem lettere å lese. Etter at vi har trykt alle seks artiklene i The Heartbeat of the Remnant, vil vi gi dem ut i et hefte. Dette er den første av seks artikler.

Innledning

Min kone og jeg hadde det privilegium å ha et frieri uten anger eller skyldfølelse. Vi var velsignet med foreldre som veiledet oss på rett vei og ga oss muligheter som de selv ikke hadde.

Hvis du ikke har et slikt vitnesbyrd eller minne, vær så snill å ikke gå rundt med skyldfølelse. Men min bønn for deg er at du får en brennende byrde og en visjon i hjertet om å gi dette til barna dine. Det kan bli din belønning.

Et Kristus-sentrert frieri er en tidsperiode mellom singellivet og ekteskapet. Beslutningene du tar i denne perioden, vil påvirke deg resten av livet. Med Guds velsignelse over livet ditt kan du ende opp uten anger eller skyldfølelse.

Fem mål for denne serien om Kristus-sentrert frieri.

Mål nr. 1. Å vende fedrenes hjerter til barna deres.

Mål nr. 2. Å vende barnas hjerter til fedrene deres.

Mål nr. 3. At foreldre må få en sterk byrde for å lede hvert av barna sine inn i Guds fullkomne vilje for livet deres.

Mål nr. 4. At unge mennesker må få en sterk byrde for å søke Gud, finne oppfyllelse og mening i å vandre med Gud, og søke modenhet i oppførsel og karakter.

Mål nr. 5. At unge menn og unge kvinner må reise seg og bli gudfryktige fedre og mødre med en visjon om å oppdra enda en gudfryktig generasjon, slik at Jesu Kristi evangelium kan føres videre.

Guds plan for mann og kvinne

Forkynneren 12:1 sier: «Husk nå din Skaper i ungdommens dager, før de onde dagene kommer, og årene nærmer seg da du skal si: ‘Jeg har ingen glede i dem.’» Mitt ønske er at hver og en av dere skal huske Skaperen i ungdommens dager. Vend hjertet, oppmerksomheten og livet ditt mot å søke Skaperen, Den Allmektige Gud i himmelen.

Hva mener han med «før de onde dagene kommer» og «årene nærmer seg»? Det betyr at du skal søke Herren mens du er ung. Bruk ungdommens energi til å søke Gud. Unge mennesker, dere er unge og fulle av ideer, visjoner, planer og drømmer. Jeg tviler på at noen av dere liker å sitte i en godstol, legge føttene opp og bare drømme om hvor forferdelig livet kommer til å bli. Det gjør vi ikke, gjør vi vel? Men hvis vi ikke vandrer med Gud og følger Guds plan, vil vanskelige ting ramme oss. Når vanskelige ting skjer i livet, har vi ingen steder å vende oss. Vi drømmer om at livet skal gå godt. Beslutningene og handlingene vi gjør i ungdommen, påvirker oss resten av livet. Den gode nyheten er at de kan påvirke oss på en god måte. Den dårlige nyheten er at de kan påvirke oss på en dårlig måte. Det kommer an på hvilke beslutninger og valg vi tar. Men unge mennesker, dere er unge, og dere har muligheten til å velge.

La oss gå til begynnelsen av Første Mosebok.

«Og Herren Gud sa: ‘Det er ikke godt for mennesket å være alene. Jeg vil gi ham en medhjelper som er hans like.’ Og Herren Gud formet av jorden alle markens dyr og alle himmelens fugler og førte dem til Adam for å se hva han ville kalle dem. Og det Adam kalte hver levende skapning, det skulle være dens navn. Adam ga navn til alt feet, himmelens fugler og alle markens dyr, men for Adam ble det ikke funnet noen medhjelper som var hans like. Da lot Herren Gud en dyp søvn komme over Adam, og han sov. Så tok han et av ribbeina hans og lukket kjøttet igjen. Og av ribbeinet som Herren Gud hadde tatt fra mannen, bygde han en kvinne og førte henne til mannen. Da sa Adam: ‘Dette er nå bein av mine bein og kjøtt av mitt kjøtt. Hun skal kalles kvinne, for av mannen er hun tatt.’ Derfor skal mannen forlate sin far og sin mor og holde seg til sin kone, og de skal være ett kjøtt.» (1. Mosebok 2:18-24).

«Og Gud sa: ‘La oss gjøre mennesker i vårt bilde, etter vår likhet. De skal råde over fiskene i havet, fuglene under himmelen, feet, hele jorden og hvert kryp som kryper på jorden.’ Og Gud skapte mennesket i sitt bilde. I Guds bilde skapte han det; til mann og kvinne skapte han dem. Og Gud velsignet dem og sa til dem: ‘Vær fruktbare, bli mange, fyll jorden og legg den under dere. Råd over fiskene i havet, fuglene under himmelen og alt levende som rører seg på jorden.’» (1. Mosebok 1:26-28).

«Og Herren Gud sa: ‘Det er ikke godt for mennesket å være alene. Jeg vil gi ham en medhjelper som er hans like.’» (1. Mosebok 2:18). «Jeg vil gi ham en medhjelper som passer for ham.» Gud sa at han ville gjøre det.

«Og Gud skapte mennesket i sitt bilde. I Guds bilde skapte han det; til mann og kvinne skapte han dem.» (1. Mosebok 1:27). Gud skapte. Gud skapte oss som mann og kvinne. Det krever mye blind tro å tro at vi utviklet oss til å bli perfekt mann og kvinne. Skapelsen av mann og kvinne er Guds plan. Det er et av de levende bevisene på skapelsen. Gud skapte. Gud skapte. Det er Guds plan. Gud er opphavsmannen. Og Guds plan bringer velsignelse.

Jeg vil gjerne se på ti forskjellige sider ved denne velsignelsen i Guds plan.

1) Gud fører Eva til Adam.

«Av ribbeinet som Herren Gud hadde tatt fra mannen, bygde han en kvinne og førte henne til mannen. Da sa Adam: ‘Dette er nå bein av mine bein og kjøtt av mitt kjøtt. Hun skal kalles kvinne, for av mannen er hun tatt.’» (1. Mosebok 2:22-23).

Gud lot Adam falle i en dyp søvn. Så skapte Gud Eva og førte henne til Adam. Adam våknet og forsto: «Denne er for meg!» Han hadde sett alle dyrene gå forbi da han ga dem navn. Nå fører Gud til ham en som er for ham. Han forsto også: «Hun ble tatt ut av min side.» Hun er nær hjertet hans. «Dette er bein av mine bein og kjøtt av mitt kjøtt.» Det er ikke en hund; det er ikke en giraff, en ape eller en sjimpanse. Denne som Gud førte til ham, er lik ham. Guds plan har en velsignelse.

Adam og Eva hadde aldri hatt en livsledsager før. Adam og Eva hadde aldri gitt slipp på følelsene i hjertet sitt før. Noe skjedde i hjertet til Adam og Eva. Adam var en «én-kvinnes-mann», og Eva var en «én-manns-kvinne». De hadde aldri gitt hjertets lidenskaper til noen andre. Gud har også denne planen for oss. Guds plan bringer velsignelser.

2) Å forlate og holde fast ved hverandre i enhet livet ut.

«Derfor skal mannen forlate sin far og sin mor og holde seg til sin kone, og de skal være ett kjøtt.» (1. Mosebok 2:24).

Dette verset sier: «Derfor skal mannen forlate sin far og sin mor», men Adam og Eva hadde ingen far og mor. Det Gud sier, er at det ikke går an å holde fast ved hverandre uten først å forlate. I Markus 10:7 leser vi også: «Derfor skal mannen forlate sin far og sin mor og holde seg til sin kone.» Dette er Guds plan, og Guds plan bringer velsignelse.

Å forlate betyr å gå bort fra, å legge bak seg. «Derfor skal mannen forlate sin far og sin mor» betyr å forlate foreldrene, å legge dem bak seg. Tenk på en ung mann som har et virkelig godt hjemmeliv. Han er velsignet og har alt han trenger. Likevel skjer det noe inni ham når Gud fører Eva inn i livet hans, og han sier: «Jeg drar!» Men dette er Guds plan. Og Guds plan bringer velsignelse.

Det handler ikke bare om å forlate far og mor; han holder seg også til sin kone. Å holde seg til betyr «å lime seg fast til, å være knyttet til». Vi kjenner godt til limte treplater. Mange slags solide møbler lages av plater som er limt sammen. Og hvis de er limt riktig, går de ikke fra hverandre i skjøtene. Hvis du river dem fra hverandre, må du rive treverket i stykker. Guds lim virker på samme måte: Det limer to mennesker sammen. Den eneste måten å rive dem fra hverandre på er å flise dem opp og rive dem fra hverandre, og det velsigner ikke Gud. Men å forlate og holde fast ved hverandre, å bli sammen og være limt sammen, det er Guds plan, og den bringer velsignelse.

3) De skal være ett kjøtt.

«Derfor skal mannen forlate sin far og sin mor og holde seg til sin kone, og de skal være ett kjøtt.» (1. Mosebok 2:24). To enslige mennesker som blir ett ektepar, blir én enhet for Gud og én familie for Gud. De blir ett kjøtt, og Gud ser dem sammen som én.

«De to skal være ett kjøtt. Så er de ikke lenger to, men ett kjøtt. Det som altså Gud har sammenføyd, skal mennesket ikke skille.» (Markus 10:8-9). Guds plan for mann og kvinne er at han fører Eva til Adam. Så skjer det at de forlater og holder fast ved hverandre. Han gjør dem til ett kjøtt. Å rive dem fra hverandre bringer ingen velsignelse, men fører med seg sorg, smerte, lidelse og sår. Det finnes ingen velsignelse i adskillelse. Men Guds plan bringer velsignelse.

4) Ikke et ulikt åk.

«Gå ikke i ulikt åk med vantro! For hva har rettferdighet med lovløshet å gjøre?» (2. Korinterbrev 6:14-15). «En kone er bundet så lenge mannen hennes lever. Men dersom mannen hennes dør, står hun fritt til å gifte seg med hvem hun vil, bare det skjer i Herren.» (1. Korinterbrev 7:39).

Guds plan er at ekteskapet skal være et likeverdig åk. Gud vil ikke føre en Eva til en Adam i et ekteskap som er et ulikt åk. La oss tenke på å forlate og holde fast ved hverandre, bli limt sammen og bli to som er ett. I ekteskapet er de to nå ett for Gud. Tenk deg å være i et dårlig ekteskap som dette – en familie som prøver å fungere sammen. Det vil ikke være noen velsignelse.

Men et likeverdig åk bringer velsignelse! Gud ønsker at vi skal være forent i ett kjøtt, ett hjerte og ett sinn. Han vil se oss forent i hjerte, sinn og kropp – hele vårt vesen – som ett. Guds plan bringer velsignelse.

5) Gud planla at vi skulle få barn.

«Og Gud velsignet dem og sa til dem: ‘Vær fruktbare, bli mange, fyll jorden og legg den under dere. Råd over fiskene i havet, fuglene under himmelen og alt levende som rører seg på jorden.’» (1. Mosebok 1:28). Tenk på gleden og mirakelet hver gang et nytt barn blir født inn i et kristent hjem. Gud planla det slik. Og hvis Gud førte Eva til Adam, og de forlater og holder fast ved hverandre, blir de ett kjøtt, ett hjerte, ett sinn. Hvis de er i et likeverdig åk og Gud velsigner dem med barn, blir hjemmet et gledelig fristed der Gud kan bo. «Og Gud velsignet Noah og sønnene hans og sa til dem: ‘Vær fruktbare, bli mange og fyll jorden.’» (1. Mosebok 9:1). «Og dere, vær fruktbare og bli mange. Bli tallrike på jorden og bli mange der.» (1. Mosebok 9:7). Guds plan bringer velsignelse.

6) Lederskapsordning.

«Men jeg vil at dere skal vite at Kristus er enhver manns hode, mannen er kvinnens hode, og Gud er Kristi hode.» (1. Korinterbrev 11:3). Det er Gud, så Kristus, mannen og kvinnen. Gud har fastsatt en lederskapsordning, og denne lederskapsordningen er en velsignelse. Det er Guds plan, og det er en velsignelse.

«Barn, vær lydige mot foreldrene deres i Herren, for dette er rett. ‘Hedre din far og din mor’ – dette er det første budet med et løfte – ‘så det kan gå deg godt, og du kan leve lenge på jorden.’» (Efeserne 6:1-3). Barn, å være lydige mot foreldrene i Herren er en del av lederskapsordningen. Dette er ikke vanskelig å forstå, er det vel? Et hjem som følger Guds plan, er rett og slett en velsignet situasjon. Unge mennesker lærer å være underordnet autoritet. Gjør det til en høy prioritet. Jo før dere lærer å være underordnet autoritet, desto bedre forberedt vil dere være på livets ansvar.

Jeg husker at jeg så for meg ekteskapet og hadde ambisjoner om å undervise barn og oppdra en gudfryktig familie. Jeg lyttet til serien «The Godly Home» og tenkte at jeg var klar til å sette i gang. Men så kom dagen da det var min tur og mitt ansvar, og plutselig ville hjertet mitt visne. Det føles ikke likt å ha ansvar som å drømme om det. DU må gjøre noe! DU er ansvarlig. DU må få det til å skje. Og forresten, ikke bare få det til å skje; du må gjøre det på en Kristus-lik måte. Du må gjøre det slik at Guds Ånds salvelse kan komme over familien din. Jo bedre vi lærer å være underordnet autoritet, desto bedre forberedt blir vi på dette ansvaret. Jo mer vi innser at vi trenger Gud, desto bedre stilt er vi. La oss gjøre det til en høy prioritet å lære å være underordnet autoritet som barn og unge. «Min sønn, glem ikke min lov, og la hjertet ditt ta vare på budene mine. For de skal gi deg mange dager, et langt liv og fred.» (Ordspråkene 3:1-2).

Gud vil legge sin velsignelse til dersom vi holder oss innenfor denne lederskapsordningen. Jo mer du lærer å være underordnet autoritet, desto mer vil du bli velsignet når du stifter hjem. Guds plan har velsignelser.

7) Et gudfryktig ekteskap.

Efeserne 5:21,22,24 sier: «Underordne dere under hverandre i ærefrykt for Kristus. Dere koner, underordne dere under deres egne menn som under Herren. . . . Slik kirken underordner seg under Kristus, skal også konene underordne seg under sine menn i alt.»

Se først på vers 21: «Underordne dere under hverandre.» Det må skje en sammensmelting i et gudfryktig hjem. Denne sammensmeltingen bør skje i gudsfrykt. Hvis vi underordner oss under hverandre i gudsfrykt, vil vi lyde Gud fordi vi ønsker hans velsignelser.

Efeserne 5:22, 24: «Dere koner, underordne dere under deres egne menn som under Herren. . . . Slik kirken underordner seg under Kristus, skal også konene underordne seg under sine menn i alt.» Unge kvinner, dere kan være sikre på dette: Å underordne seg under far tilsvarer å underordne seg under en ektemann. Dere kan øve dere mens dere er ugifte. Dette vil bidra til å bygge karakter i livet deres. Å være en opprørsk og egenrådig kvinne vil ikke bringe Guds velsignelse.

Videre står det i Efeserne 5:25,28,29: «Dere menn, elsk konene deres, slik Kristus elsket kirken og ga seg selv for den . . . Slik skylder mennene å elske konene sine som sin egen kropp. Den som elsker sin kone, elsker seg selv. Ingen har noen gang hatet sin egen kropp, men han gir den mat og pleier den, slik Herren gjør med kirken.» Unge menn, her står det at menn skal elske konene sine. Så hvem tror dere Gud har satt i livet deres for å forberede dere på å elske konen deres? Moren deres! Vil dere lære å elske konen deres? Lær å komme godt overens med moren deres, elsk henne og bry dere om henne. Vil du øve deg på å elske den framtidige konen din? Da kan du begynne med å elske moren din.

Vers 33: «Men hver enkelt av dere skal elske sin kone som seg selv, og kona skal ha respekt for mannen sin.» Guds plan bringer velsignelser.

8) Å være medarvinger til livets nåde.

1. Peter 3:7: «På samme måte skal dere menn leve sammen med konene deres med forståelse og vise konen ære, som det svakere kar, og som medarvinger til livets nåde, slik at bønnene deres ikke blir hindret.» Som ektemenn viser vi konen ære. Hun er det svakere karet, og hun er den som fødte barna! Hun har gjennomgått mange traumatiske forandringer i livet. Hun er den som blir utslitt og blir trett før.

Og han sier: «Dere menn, lev sammen med dem med forståelse.»

Unge menn, lær å forstå moren deres og søstrene deres. Det vil hjelpe dere etter at dere gifter dere. Ikke konkluder med at – ah, det er bare slik kvinner er. Nei, dere ønsker Guds velsignelse. Lær å kjenne og forstå dem.

«Medarvinger til livets nåde.» Gud vil at vi skal være medarvinger til livets nåde. Hvis vi ikke er medarvinger til livets nåde, kan vi da være arvinger til livets nåde hver for oss? Det tror jeg ikke. Han sier at vi skal være medarvinger, slik at bønnene våre ikke blir hindret. Så hvis vi er arvinger hver for oss, kan vi da si at bønnene våre blir hindret? Ja, bønnene våre blir hindret. La oss vise konen ære som det svakere karet. Hver eneste lille framgang du kan gjøre på dette området, vil bare velsigne deg senere. Det er verdt det. Guds plan bringer velsignelse.

9) Et velsignet og trygt hjem.

Dette henter vi delvis fra 1. Peter 3:7, men også fra Salme 144:12: «Våre sønner skal være som planter, som vokser opp i ungdommen, våre døtre som hjørnesteiner, hugget ut som til et palass.» Guds nåde hviler over et trygt hjem der det er enhet. Der far forstår mor, der far bryr seg om mor. Far tjener og er der for å hjelpe og veilede. Han er der for å gi retning med et medfølende hjerte. Guds plan for mann og kvinne – Guds plan bringer velsignelser.

10) Slik Kristus og kirken er.

«Slik kirken underordner seg under Kristus, skal også konene underordne seg under sine menn i alt. Dere menn, elsk konene deres, slik Kristus elsket kirken og ga seg selv for den, for å hellige den og rense den ved vannbadet i kraft av ordet, og for å føre kirken fram for seg i herlighet, uten flekk eller rynke eller noe slikt, men hellig og uten feil. Slik skylder mennene å elske konene sine som sin egen kropp. Den som elsker sin kone, elsker seg selv. Ingen har noen gang hatet sin egen kropp, men han gir den mat og pleier den, slik Herren gjør med kirken.» (Efeserne 5:24-29).

«Dere menn, elsk konene deres, slik Kristus elsket kirken og ga seg selv for den.» Gud ser etter menn som er villige til å gi livet sitt. Ugifte unge menn, er dere villige til å svare på kallet og gi livet deres? Dette er et høyt kall fra Gud. Det er Guds plan.

Unge menn, er dere villige til å gi avkall på livet deres, planene deres og de tingene dere liker å gjøre på egen hånd? Er dere villige til å være tålmodige, milde og forståelsesfulle? Er dere villige til å miste søvn og fortsette selv når dere er trøtte? Er dere villige til å holde dere rolige og ikke reagere under stressende omstendigheter? Er dere villige til å lede og veilede en kone og barn, evige sjeler, gjennom dette livet?

Men min bønn er at dere frivillig vil stille dere til rådighet og si: «Jeg er villig til å vie meg til Guds Ord, Guds vilje og Guds plan, og jeg vil gi livet mitt. Jeg er villig til å legge det på alteret.» Jesus ga livet sitt for oss, og han sammenligner ekteskapet med kirken og seg selv.

Det er også behov for mødre som underordner seg og bøyer seg for autoritet. Mødre som ikke følger vår tids kvinnefrigjøring, men heller er tilfredse med å være hjemmets voktere.

Unge kvinner, er dere villige til å melde dere? Vil dere gi hjertet deres for å bli veiledet og ledet? Er dere villige til å følge og med glede underordne dere under autoriteten deres? Er dere villige til å tjene og slite dere ut for familien deres? Er dere villige til å tjene og slite dere ut for DERES familie? Hvis dere gifter dere en dag, vil det være DERES familie dere skal tjene og slite dere ut for. Er dere villige til å tåle smerte og ubehag? Er dere villige til å være en medhjelper, og gi av dere selv for hans byrde og visjon?

Men når vi ser på Guds plan og velsignelser, ønsker dere Guds velsignelse, unge mennesker! Men da må dere også ta valg som samsvarer med den. Reis dere og ta beslutninger som fører til modenhet. Modenhet kommer gjennom prosessen med å søke Gud. Bestem dere i hjertet for å åpne dere for Guds velsignelser og prinsipper. Jeg oppmuntrer dere til å vandre med Gud, ha et forhold til Jesus Kristus og gjøre det i ydmykhet.

Søk Kristus-lik karakter, og gjør det med hensikt. Det er så lett for oss bare å leve livet slik det faller seg. Men hvis vi tar beslutninger med hensikt, vil de føre oss et sted! Disse beslutningene betyr noe. Gjør ting etter Guds plan.

Gud har en plan for mann og kvinne, og han har en plan for deg.

Eight-year-old Jamin wasn’t very smart. Or at least that’s what his older brother told him. Almost daily, brother Kenny found ways to remind Jamin of his shortcomings and laugh at his blunders.

“Jamin, you will never be smart”, Kenny said. Deep inside Jamin felt resigned to a life of muddled trip-ups. Would he always be clumsy? Would he always say things wrong? That’s what Kenny said.

Jamin believed Kenny’s lectures with wide-eyed belief. Kenny was three years older than him, so he must be right. Very well, then Jamin would be simple. Kenny would be smart. Life was not fair. Dad and Mom disliked Kenny’s proud talk and punished him whenever they walked in on one of his speeches. But Kenny had a way of avoiding earshot. So he continued mocking Jamin.

Grandma Otto watched these trials from her rocker on the porch. She was a quiet old lady.

“Jamin, do you know where Kenny is?” Mom asked with a smile. “It’s almost supper time.”

“He went to check his coyote traps. I’ll go find him.”

There was a chill in the air as he tramped up over the lawn, and the sun was growing old as he crossed the border of the woods. The fleeting shadows scurried over the hills. The chill deepened as he stumped further in. He breathed the rich air and followed Kenny’s trail. Eventually, the trail would end up in a meadow, but Jamin hoped he would find Kenny before he had to go that far. The various traps had been checked already, so Jamin knew Kenny had come this way. Jamin trudged on resolutely. His golden head caught the tired beams that fled from the sun as they flickered through the trees. And soon those too had faded leaving behind the musky smell of the woods. The fall webworms had been at work, and their web curtains shuttered from branches overhead.

At length, as the trees subdued and thinned, and the meadow appeared Jamin knew this was the end of his brother’s trap route. If Kenny wasn’t here, he wouldn’t know where else to look.

But Kenny was there. As Jamin clumped into the meadow, he could see a frustrated heap to his right. The heap’s voice had a familiar ring. The heap’s face was lit in pain. The heap was Kenny. “Are you alright? What happened?” Jamin felt strange, seeing Kenny scrunched in the dirt. Kenny was smart. “Did you step in a trap?”

“Yes, Jamin. I..I wasn’t looking where I was going. Help me. Please.”

Jamin bent and found an ankle firmly held in the jaws of a steel trap. Darkness stained the ground around Kenny. Quickly, Jamin’s strong arms pried open the jaws. Kenny reeled free. “Can you walk?”

“Yes. I think so. If you support me, I can hobble along.”

“Dad and Mom will be worried. We’ve missed supper.”

Sure enough, as the brothers hobbled back through the woods, they heard the long calling of their father. Jamin called back, and he was by their side in a moment, seeing the ankle and scooping up Kenny like a hurt sheep. The odd little band hurried home, and the screen door banged shut as Dad swept across the porch. Jamin went to the wash house and scrubbed his hands. He headed for the front door.

“Jamin.” It was Grandma. The porch light showed her in her old rocker. A heavy comforter lay on her shoulders.

“Yes, Grandma?”

“Do you think you are not very smart?”

“That’s what Kenny says.” Jamin squirmed.

“You were strong enough to open the trap, and Kenny wasn’t. You were brave enough to find him in the dark. Lots of young boys wouldn’t be.” Jamin was silent. Grandma Otto rocked some more, then smiled. “God made you the way you are for a reason, Jamin. He made Kenny the way he is for a reason. He has a plan for you, and a place only you can fill, you know.”

Jamin turned and walked into the warm kitchen. He was smiling.

Восьмилетний Джамин вовсе не был очень умным. По крайней мере, так говорил ему старший брат. Почти каждый день Кенни находил способ напомнить Джамину о его недостатках и посмеяться над его промахами.

«Джамин, ты никогда не будешь умным», — говорил Кенни. В глубине души Джамин смирился с мыслью о жизни, полной путаных неудач. Всегда ли он будет неуклюжим? Всегда ли будет говорить не то? Так говорил Кенни.

Джамин с широко раскрытыми глазами верил каждой лекции Кенни. Кенни был на три года старше, значит, он должен быть прав. Что ж, тогда Джамин будет простаком. А Кенни — умным. Жизнь была несправедлива. Папе и маме не нравились хвастливые речи Кенни, и они наказывали его всякий раз, когда заставали его за одной из таких речей. Но Кенни умел так говорить, чтобы они не слышали. Поэтому он продолжал насмехаться над Джамином.

Бабушка Отто наблюдала за этими испытаниями из своего кресла-качалки на веранде. Она была тихой старушкой.

«Джамин, ты знаешь, где Кенни?» — с улыбкой спросила мама. «Уже почти время ужина».

«Он пошёл проверить капканы на койотов. Я пойду его найду».

Когда Джамин вразвалку пересёк лужайку, в воздухе чувствовалась прохлада, а солнце уже клонилось к закату. Он вошёл в лес. Мимолётные тени суетливо пробегали по холмам. Чем дальше он продвигался, тем сильнее становилась прохлада. Он вдыхал насыщенный запах леса и шёл по следу Кенни. В конце концов тропа должна была вывести на луг, но Джамин надеялся найти Кенни, не заходя так далеко. Все капканы уже проверили, поэтому Джамин знал, что Кенни проходил здесь. Джамин решительно шагал вперёд. Его золотистые волосы ловили усталые лучи заходящего солнца, мерцавшие сквозь деревья. Вскоре угасли и они, оставив после себя мускусный запах леса. Осенние паутинные черви уже потрудились, и их паутинные завесы свисали с ветвей над головой.

Наконец деревья поредели, и показался луг. Джамин понял, что здесь заканчивался маршрут Кенни по проверке капканов. Если Кенни не окажется здесь, Джамин не знал, где ещё его искать.

Но Кенни был там. Когда Джамин ввалился на луг, справа он увидел беспомощно скорчившуюся фигуру. Голос фигуры показался ему знакомым. Лицо её было искажено болью. Это был Кенни. «Ты в порядке? Что случилось?» Джамину было непривычно видеть Кенни съёжившимся в грязи. Кенни ведь был умным. «Ты попал в капкан?»

«Да, Джамин. Я... я не смотрел, куда иду. Помоги мне. Пожалуйста».

Джамин нагнулся и увидел, что лодыжка крепко зажата стальными челюстями капкана. Земля вокруг Кенни погрузилась во тьму. Джамин быстро разжал челюсти сильными руками. Кенни высвободился. «Ты можешь идти?»

«Да. Думаю, да. Если ты меня поддержишь, я смогу ковылять».

«Папа и мама будут волноваться. Мы пропустили ужин».

И правда, когда братья, прихрамывая, возвращались через лес, они услышали протяжный зов отца. Джамин отозвался, и отец тут же оказался рядом. Увидев лодыжку, он подхватил Кенни, как раненую овцу. Эта необычная маленькая компания поспешила домой. Когда отец стремительно пересёк веранду, сетчатая дверь с грохотом захлопнулась. Джамин пошёл в прачечную и тщательно вымыл руки. Затем направился к входной двери.

«Джамин». Это была бабушка. Свет на веранде освещал её, сидевшую в старом кресле-качалке. На её плечах лежал тяжёлый плед.

«Да, бабушка?»

«Ты думаешь, что ты не очень умный?»

«Так говорит Кенни». Джамин заёрзал.

«Ты был достаточно силён, чтобы открыть капкан, а Кенни — нет. Ты был достаточно храбр, чтобы найти его в темноте. Многие мальчики не смогли бы этого сделать». Джамин молчал. Бабушка Отто ещё немного покачалась в кресле, затем улыбнулась. «Бог создал тебя таким не просто так, Джамин. Бог создал и Кенни таким не просто так. У Него есть план для тебя и место, которое можешь занять только ты».

Джамин повернулся и вошёл в тёплую кухню. Он улыбался.

I can still smell the tantalizing cacophony of odors as I clutched my father’s strong hand, weaving our way through the masses of tourists that crowded the building. The vendors at the Green Dragon Farmer’s Market in Ephrata, PA, were trying their best to entice buyers with their rows of fresh fish over ice, cheeses of every variety, deli meat and sandwiches, and piles of fresh fruit. And, oh, the candy! My young preschool mind had never seen so many delectable sweets in one place at one time.

The past two days for me were like the boy at the candy store. I had the privilege of attending Christian Aid Ministries’ first Annual Writers’ Conference. I brushed shoulders with well-known authors such as Katrina Hoover Lee, Johnny Miller, and Ruthann Stelfox. I chatted with aspiring writers and seasoned school teachers. I had the opportunity to sit under hours of inspirational and educational workshops on how to write to communicate, using realistic dialog, descriptive writing, and much more. We all had one common goal in mind. Together, we share and learn how to effectively communicate what is in our hearts, and through the power of the written word, transmit those thoughts to your hearts.

The Heartbeat of the Remnant is a means to communicate inspirational thoughts to eager readers scattered across the globe. Courageous writers step forward with pen and paper or keyboard and monitor and help spread the Good News of the Word of God with caution, correction, and edification. Yet, we need more such writers. We need young believers who bravely submit their first children’s stories. Seasoned grandfathers who bring words of admonishment to the younger generation. Mothers who share experiences and trials with other mothers who are in the throes of raising little ones. Youth encouraging fellow youth to press toward the mark of the prize of the high calling in Christ Jesus. Fathers who with a concerned eye watch the world pressing in on the Christian homes. Together, these aspiring writers will produce a periodical that will endure on the family coffee table for many years. I encourage you, fellow believers, to give it a try. Nelson Mandela, former president of South Africa wrote, “Failure is a teacher, and at the end of your life, what do you think you’ll feel worst about, failing or never trying?”

The Berean Voice has a goal to provide printed material that will help readers navigate through the varied and difficult seasons of life. All our material is available at no charge, but we are dependent on the donations of our supporters. Here is a list of books we have available:

The Power of the Love of Truth
Christian Counseling- Counterfeit?
The Heart of God
Free Indeed!
Pilgrims and Politics
Cup & Cross
The High Cost of Holistic Healing
Secrets of Successful Writing
The Catholic Connection
Psychiatry and Mood altering Medications
The Mennonite Church and Modernism

In 2017 and 2018, the Berean Voice printed a series of vaccine articles in The Heartbeat of the Remnant magazine. These articles were a sincere effort to examine various aspects of vaccine usage with an unbiased approach. We attempted to present the facts as clearly as possible and let the readers draw their own conclusions.

Since then, we have received numerous requests from our readers to publish all the vaccine articles in a booklet, which we agreed to do. But then along came 2019, bringing coronavirus with it. This monumental event upended the vaccine debate and ushered in a frenzied rush to market COVID-19 remedies, many of which were not properly tested. We put the printing on hold, unsure whether to include information on these new and unproven COVID-19 “vaccines.” As time progressed and the deadly nature of COVID-19 abated, we decided to publish the original vaccine articles in a booklet without any additional articles on the COVID-19 debate. We are pleased that the project is nearing completion and will be announced when it is released.

Blessings to all,

Edward Martin

Je peux encore sentir la cacophonie alléchante des odeurs tandis que je serrais la main robuste de mon père, nous frayant un chemin parmi les foules de touristes qui encombraient le bâtiment. Les vendeurs du Green Dragon Farmer’s Market à Ephrata, en Pennsylvanie, faisaient de leur mieux pour attirer les acheteurs avec leurs rangées de poissons frais sur glace, des fromages de toutes sortes, de la charcuterie et des sandwiches, et des tas de fruits frais. Et, oh, les bonbons ! Mon jeune esprit de préscolaire n’avait jamais vu autant de douceurs alléchantes réunies au même endroit.

Ces deux derniers jours ont été pour moi comme pour le garçon dans la confiserie. J’ai eu le privilège d’assister à la première conférence annuelle des écrivains organisée par Christian Aid Ministries. J’ai croisé des auteurs connus tels que Katrina Hoover Lee, Johnny Miller et Ruthann Stelfox. J’ai discuté avec des aspirants écrivains et des professeurs d’école expérimentés. J’ai eu l’occasion d’assister à des heures d’ateliers inspirants et pédagogiques sur la façon d’écrire pour communiquer, en utilisant des dialogues réalistes, une écriture descriptive, et bien plus encore. Nous avions tous un objectif commun. Ensemble, nous partageons et apprenons comment communiquer efficacement ce qui est dans nos cœurs et, par le pouvoir de l’écrit, transmettre ces pensées dans vos cœurs.

The Heartbeat of the Remnant est un moyen de communiquer des pensées inspirantes à des lecteurs avides répartis à travers le monde. Des écrivains courageux se présentent, plume et papier ou clavier et écran, et contribuent à répandre la Bonne Nouvelle de la Parole de Dieu avec prudence, correction et édification. Pourtant, nous avons besoin de davantage de tels écrivains. Nous avons besoin de jeunes croyants qui présentent courageusement leurs premières histoires pour enfants. De grands-pères expérimentés qui apportent des paroles d’avertissement à la jeune génération. De mères qui partagent leurs expériences et leurs épreuves avec d’autres mères aux prises avec les exigences de l’éducation de jeunes enfants. De jeunes qui encouragent leurs pairs à poursuivre la course vers le prix de l’appel élevé en Jésus-Christ. De pères qui, d’un œil inquiet, observent le monde faire pression sur les foyers chrétiens. Ensemble, ces écrivains en herbe produiront une revue qui restera sur la table basse familiale pendant de nombreuses années. Je vous encourage, frères et sœurs en Christ, à tenter votre chance. Nelson Mandela, ancien président de l’Afrique du Sud, a écrit : « L’échec est un maître, et à la fin de votre vie, de quoi pensez-vous que vous vous sentirez le plus mal : d’avoir échoué ou de ne jamais avoir essayé ? »

Le Berean Voice a pour objectif de fournir des documents imprimés qui aideront les lecteurs à traverser les saisons variées et difficiles de la vie. Tout notre matériel est disponible gratuitement, mais nous dépendons des dons de nos soutiens. Voici une liste des livres que nous avons disponibles :

La puissance de l’amour de la vérité
Conseil chrétien : contrefaçon ?
Le cœur de Dieu
Libres en vérité !
Pèlerins et politique
Coupe et croix
Le coût élevé de la guérison holistique
Secrets de l’écriture réussie
La connexion catholique
Psychiatrie et médicaments modifiant l’humeur
L’Église mennonite et le modernisme

En 2017 et 2018, le Berean Voice a publié une série d’articles sur les vaccins dans le magazine The Heartbeat of the Remnant. Ces articles étaient un effort sincère pour examiner divers aspects de l’utilisation des vaccins avec une approche impartiale. Nous avons tenté de présenter les faits aussi clairement que possible et de laisser les lecteurs tirer leurs propres conclusions.

Depuis lors, nous avons reçu de nombreuses demandes de la part de nos lecteurs pour publier tous les articles sur les vaccins dans un livret, ce que nous avons accepté de faire. Puis est arrivé 2019, apportant avec lui le coronavirus. Cet événement monumental a bouleversé le débat sur les vaccins et a ouvert la voie à une ruée effrénée pour commercialiser des remèdes contre la COVID-19, dont beaucoup n’étaient pas correctement testés. Nous avons mis l’impression en attente, ne sachant pas s’il fallait inclure des informations sur ces nouveaux « vaccins » contre la COVID-19 non éprouvés. Avec le temps et l’atténuation du caractère mortel de la COVID-19, nous avons décidé de publier les articles originaux sur les vaccins dans un livret sans articles supplémentaires sur le débat concernant la COVID-19. Nous sommes heureux que le projet soit presque achevé et qu’il sera annoncé lors de sa sortie.

Bénédictions à tous,

Edward Martin

Circumstantial overload might be the most difficult. We can choose not to go to a Norwex party if we need to give our schedule some space. But if a child breaks a leg in the middle of wedding preparations, we have no choice other than to make the best of the situation.

Circumstantial overload may happen slowly, as in the following story, or it may happen quickly as in the case of an accident in which a family member is injured.

Becky is in her thirties with seven children under seventeen. A few years ago, one of their chicken houses burned down. At the time, they were thankful that the chickens had left the day before and that no one was close by when the propane tank exploded.

“My husband faced the disaster like a man,” says Becky. “His calm spirit helped me relax. I felt certain that we could make the financial adjustments and life would go on as before. But I was wrong. Very wrong.”

“In time the mess was cleaned up, and Rick looked into rebuilding. The quotes were higher than expected, so he opted to do some of the work himself. He also took on a part-time job to provide more income. Our boys were old enough to help, yet they couldn’t do much without Rick’s direction.”

“I first felt the adjustment in my wallet, but I consoled myself that this was only temporary. Then the spark in Rick’s eyes was replaced with a dull stare. He became distant from us. I knew something wasn’t right, but I couldn’t put my finger on it.”

“Then he was elected to finish the last four months of secretarial duties for a brother who spent some time in Bulgaria. That night he came home and wept. ‘Doesn’t anyone understand what I’m going through? Every time I turn around, there is something to do. The boys want to go fishing, you need a new clothesline, and the chicken house needs to be finished in six months! I am not mentally capable of handling one more duty.’”

“That was the straw that broke the camel’s back,” Becky said. “I became alarmed when I heard him yawning in the middle of the night and knew that he was not sleeping.”

“It was clear to me that my perfectionist husband was overloaded. More and more Rick leaned on me. I cut back on my commitments and tried to keep my time free so that I was available to help lessen his load.”

“I felt like a lifeguard trying to keep a man from drowning while taking in a bit too much water myself. Many of the home-life responsibilities fell on my shoulders. Then I was asked to fill the position of food committee for Mrs. ‘Going-to-Bulgaria.’”

Unfortunately, circumstantial stress is often unnoticed. Worse yet, the victim can be misunderstood or misjudged. Becky said, “My darkest day came when I was accused of being selfish with my time because I declined the food committee request.”

Prolonged overload can be emotionally and mentally damaging

Intense, long-lasting pressures or troubles shouldered alone can cause severe stress. Minor stress is normal, but prolonged stress can cause depression, anxiety, heart disease, and high blood pressure. How you handle prolonged stress is important.

Sometimes this type of overload is not public knowledge. Traumatic events in our plain circles tend to receive prayer, finances, and weekly budget updates. At the same time, other saints are suffering deeply on the sidelines with little recognition or financial aid. It could be strained relationships or little bills that add up to a big sum. Betrayal and rejection cause stress beyond measure. There are no quick fixes to circumstantial stress, but little sparks of light can help you navigate the darkness.

Talk about your situation with someone you trust

Sometimes just talking about problems can help you to put issues in perspective. Hearing yourself verbalize a stressful situation somehow clears brain fog and gives a clearer path forward.

Find routine

When stress prevails, racing thoughts, forgetfulness, and inability to focus comes uninvited. Having a routine can bring some rhythm to your mental well-being. The smallest normalcy brings a moment of pleasure, and it is soothing to the soul.

Intentionally seek a breather

Lingering stress can cause agitation, moodiness, and the desire to take control. Sometimes it is hard to think beyond mental fog, but it is so important to find refreshment for your mental wellbeing. Stress hormones can speed up your heart rate and tighten your blood vessels. That temporarily raises your blood pressure. The opposite happens when you relax. Being relaxed helps you have a calmer, clearer mind which improves your concentration and decision-making.

Believe that God cares

Say it. Read the Psalms over and over. Listen to good music. Take short walks and pray aloud. Keep your eyes on Jesus. Believe “Weeping may endure for a night, but joy cometh in the morning” (Psalm 30:5).

If you are facing circumstantial overload, be patient and realistic. God will make a way for you. Many times, He opens doors just when we are running out of options. He will supply the needed grace for that hour. And the next hour. And the next. At times, surprising opportunities come, and prayers are answered in unexpected ways. However He chooses to work on your behalf, hold to His unchanging hand.

Regardless of the type of overload you might be encountering, turn to your Heavenly Father.

Ask Him for direction and wisdom. And say with the Psalmist, “In thee, O LORD, do I put my trust: let me never be put to confusion” (Psalm 71:1).

परिस्थितियों का अतिभार शायद सबसे कठिन हो सकता है। अगर हमें अपने कार्यक्रम में कुछ खाली जगह चाहिए, तो हम किसी Norwex पार्टी में न जाने का चुनाव कर सकते हैं। लेकिन अगर शादी की तैयारियों के बीच किसी बच्चे की टांग टूट जाए, तो स्थिति से सर्वोत्तम ढंग से निपटने के अलावा हमारे पास कोई विकल्प नहीं होता।

परिस्थितियों का अतिभार धीरे-धीरे हो सकता है, जैसा कि आगे की कहानी में है, या फिर अचानक, जैसे उस दुर्घटना में जिसमें परिवार का कोई सदस्य घायल हो जाता है।

बेकी तीस की उम्र में हैं और उनके सात बच्चे सत्रह साल से कम उम्र के हैं। कुछ साल पहले, उनके मुर्गीघर में आग लग गई थी। उस समय वे इस बात के आभारी थे कि मुर्गियाँ एक दिन पहले ही वहाँ से निकल गई थीं और प्रोपेन टैंक के फटने के समय कोई भी पास नहीं था।

“मेरे पति ने उस विपत्ति का सामना एक पुरुष की तरह किया,” बेकी कहती हैं। “उनके शांत स्वभाव ने मुझे भी शांत होने में मदद की। मुझे यकीन था कि हम आर्थिक बदलावों के साथ तालमेल बिठा लेंगे और जीवन पहले की तरह चलता रहेगा। लेकिन मैं गलत थी। बहुत गलत।”

“कुछ समय बाद मलबा साफ़ हो गया और रिक ने फिर से निर्माण करने की संभावना पर विचार किया। अनुमानित लागत अपेक्षा से अधिक थी, इसलिए उन्होंने कुछ काम खुद करने का फैसला किया। अधिक आमदनी के लिए उन्होंने अंशकालिक नौकरी भी कर ली। हमारे लड़के मदद करने के लिए काफी बड़े थे, फिर भी रिक के निर्देशन के बिना वे ज़्यादा कुछ नहीं कर सकते थे।”

“सबसे पहले मुझे अपने बटुए पर इस बदलाव का असर महसूस हुआ, लेकिन मैंने खुद को यह कहकर सांत्वना दी कि यह केवल अस्थायी है। फिर रिक की आँखों की चमक फीकी पड़कर नीरस घूरने में बदल गई। वह हमसे दूर-दूर रहने लगे। मुझे पता था कि कुछ ठीक नहीं है, लेकिन मैं समझ नहीं पा रही थी कि बात क्या है।”

“फिर उन्हें उस भाई के लिए सचिवीय कर्तव्यों के आखिरी चार महीने पूरे करने के लिए चुना गया, जो कुछ समय के लिए बुल्गारिया गया था। उस रात वह घर आए और रो पड़े। ‘क्या कोई नहीं समझता कि मैं किस दौर से गुजर रहा हूँ? जिधर भी देखता हूँ, कुछ न कुछ करने को होता है। लड़के मछली पकड़ने जाना चाहते हैं, तुम्हें कपड़े सुखाने की नई रस्सी चाहिए, और मुर्गीघर छह महीने में पूरा होना है! मैं मानसिक रूप से एक और ज़िम्मेदारी सँभालने में सक्षम नहीं हूँ।’”

“यही वह तिनका था जिसने ऊँट की पीठ तोड़ दी,” बेकी ने कहा। “जब मैंने उन्हें आधी रात में जम्हाई लेते सुना, तो मैं चिंतित हो गई और समझ गई कि उन्हें नींद नहीं आ रही थी।”

“मेरे लिए यह स्पष्ट था कि मेरे पूर्णतावादी पति पर बहुत ज़्यादा बोझ था। रिक मुझ पर और अधिक निर्भर होने लगे। मैंने अपनी प्रतिबद्धताएँ कम कर दीं और अपना समय खाली रखने की कोशिश की, ताकि उनके बोझ को कम करने में मदद के लिए उपलब्ध रह सकूँ।”

“मुझे ऐसा लगा मानो मैं एक जीवनरक्षक हूँ, जो किसी डूबते हुए व्यक्ति को बचाने की कोशिश कर रही है, जबकि खुद भी कुछ ज़्यादा पानी निगल रही हूँ। घर-परिवार की कई ज़िम्मेदारियाँ मेरे कंधों पर आ गईं। फिर मुझे ‘बुल्गारिया जा रही’ श्रीमती के लिए भोजन-समिति का पद सँभालने को कहा गया।”

दुर्भाग्यवश, परिस्थितियों से उपजा तनाव अक्सर अनदेखा रह जाता है। इससे भी बुरा यह है कि पीड़ित व्यक्ति को गलत समझा जा सकता है या उसके बारे में गलत राय बनाई जा सकती है। बेकी ने कहा, “मेरा सबसे अँधेरा दिन तब आया जब मुझ पर अपने समय के मामले में स्वार्थी होने का आरोप लगाया गया, क्योंकि मैंने भोजन-समिति के अनुरोध को अस्वीकार कर दिया था।”

लंबे समय तक बना रहने वाला अतिभार भावनात्मक और मानसिक रूप से नुकसानदेह हो सकता है

तीव्र और लंबे समय तक चलने वाले दबाव या अकेले झेले गए कष्ट गंभीर तनाव पैदा कर सकते हैं। मामूली तनाव सामान्य है, लेकिन लंबे समय तक बना रहने वाला तनाव अवसाद, चिंता, हृदय रोग और उच्च रक्तचाप का कारण बन सकता है। यह महत्वपूर्ण है कि आप लंबे समय तक बने रहने वाले तनाव से कैसे निपटते हैं।

कभी-कभी इस प्रकार का अतिभार सार्वजनिक रूप से ज्ञात नहीं होता। हमारे साधारण समुदायों में होने वाली आघातकारी घटनाओं के लिए अक्सर प्रार्थना, आर्थिक सहायता और साप्ताहिक बजट की जानकारी मिलती है। वहीं, दूसरे संत गुमनामी में गहरे कष्ट झेल रहे होते हैं और उन्हें बहुत कम पहचान या आर्थिक सहायता मिलती है। यह तनावपूर्ण रिश्तों या छोटे-छोटे बिलों की वजह से हो सकता है, जो जुड़कर बड़ी रकम बन जाते हैं। विश्वासघात और अस्वीकृति बेहिसाब तनाव पैदा करते हैं। परिस्थितियों से उपजे तनाव का कोई त्वरित समाधान नहीं है, लेकिन उम्मीद की छोटी-छोटी किरणें अँधेरे में राह खोजने में आपकी मदद कर सकती हैं।

किसी भरोसेमंद व्यक्ति से अपनी स्थिति के बारे में बात करें

कभी-कभी समस्याओं के बारे में बात करना ही आपको मामलों को सही परिप्रेक्ष्य में देखने में मदद कर सकता है। तनावपूर्ण स्थिति के बारे में अपने मुँह से बोलकर सुनना किसी तरह दिमाग़ी धुंध को साफ़ करता है और आगे बढ़ने का रास्ता अधिक स्पष्ट कर देता है।

दिनचर्या बनाएँ

जब तनाव हावी होता है, तो तेज़ी से दौड़ते विचार, भूलने की समस्या और ध्यान केंद्रित न कर पाना बिन बुलाए आ जाते हैं। दिनचर्या से आपके मानसिक स्वास्थ्य में कुछ लय आ सकती है। रोज़मर्रा की छोटी-सी सामान्य बात भी आनंद का एक पल ला सकती है और आत्मा को सुकून देती है।

जानबूझकर थोड़ा विश्राम करें

लंबे समय तक बना रहने वाला तनाव बेचैनी, चिड़चिड़ापन और नियंत्रण अपने हाथ में लेने की इच्छा पैदा कर सकता है। कभी-कभी दिमाग़ी धुंध के पार सोचना मुश्किल होता है, लेकिन अपने मानसिक स्वास्थ्य के लिए ताज़गी पाने का रास्ता ढूँढ़ना बहुत ज़रूरी है। तनाव के हार्मोन आपके दिल की धड़कन तेज़ कर सकते हैं और रक्त वाहिकाओं को संकुचित कर सकते हैं। इससे आपका रक्तचाप अस्थायी रूप से बढ़ जाता है। जब आप आराम करते हैं, तो इसका उलटा होता है। आराम करने से आपका मन शांत और स्पष्ट होता है, जिससे आपकी एकाग्रता और निर्णय लेने की क्षमता बेहतर होती है।

विश्वास रखें कि परमेश्वर परवाह करते हैं

इसे कहें। भजन संहिता को बार-बार पढ़ें। अच्छा संगीत सुनें। थोड़ी देर टहलें और ऊँची आवाज़ में प्रार्थना करें। अपनी नज़रें यीशु पर टिकाए रखें। विश्वास कीजिए, “रात भर रोना ठहर सकता है, पर भोर होते ही जयजयकार होती है” (भजन संहिता 30:5)।

यदि आप परिस्थितियों के अतिभार का सामना कर रहे हैं, तो धैर्य रखें और वास्तविकता को ध्यान में रखें। परमेश्वर आपके लिए मार्ग बनाएँगे। कई बार, जब हमारे विकल्प समाप्त होने लगते हैं, तभी वे दरवाज़े खोलते हैं। उस घड़ी के लिए वे आवश्यक अनुग्रह देंगे। और अगली घड़ी के लिए भी। और उसके बाद वाली घड़ी के लिए भी। कभी-कभी आश्चर्यजनक अवसर आते हैं और प्रार्थनाओं के उत्तर अप्रत्याशित तरीकों से मिलते हैं। वे आपकी ओर से जिस भी तरह काम करना चुनें, उनके अटल हाथ को थामे रहें।

आप जिस भी प्रकार के अतिभार का सामना कर रहे हों, अपने स्वर्गीय पिता की ओर मुड़ें।

उनसे मार्गदर्शन और बुद्धि माँगें। और भजनकार के साथ कहें, “हे यहोवा, मैं तुझ पर भरोसा रखता हूँ; मुझे कभी लज्जित न होने दे” (भजन संहिता 71:1)।
